text: {"lessons":["My repeated sales of Stock E winners felt satisfying, but realized gains alone do not show whether selling was the best choice; I should assess the position and portfolio as a whole.","I should not let reluctance to admit a mistake keep me holding a losing position, or let loss aversion make me avoid a sound decision.","With random price movements and few changes in my account, patience is useful: I should trade only when my portfolio needs rebalancing or my investment reasoning changes."]}
